[element-related-article]
=== `<related-article>` Related Journal Article Information

Description of, and typically a link to, a journal article related to the standards document.

#### Related Elements

There are two linking elements in this Tag Set that can be used to point related journal article, books, conference proceedings, etc.: The <<element-related-article,`<related-article>`>> names related journal articles, such as companion articles or a short news piece based on the document, and The <<element-related-object,`<related-object>`>> names other sorts of related sources, such as a dataset, a related book, or a figure from another published source.
